results.title: Night King
results.overview: The once-glamourous nightclub EJ Entertainment suddenly experiences a hostile takeover. Much like the nightclub industry, the glory days are over for the club’s manager, despite having stood tall in East Tsim Sha Tsui for decades. To make matters worse, the new CEO is none other than his cutthroat ex-wife.

results.title: Mahakavya: Shri Ramayan Katha
results.overview: A futuristic drama based on the story of the great epic Ramayana with the emotional filming and presentation of the events of Shri Ram's life which has never been seen on screen till now.

results.title: Dark Hollow
results.overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

results.title: A Statement
results.overview: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

results.title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 9
results.original_title: NJPW Road to The New Beginning 2026 - Day 9
results.overview: The ninth night of Road to The New Beginning 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 7, 2026, at Habikino City Sports Center in Habikino, Osaka, Japan.

results.title: Zoglins: Horror on the Road with no Light
results.original_title: Zoglins: Horror da Estrada Sem Luz
results.overview: Horror on the road with no light!

results.title: Fukushima: A Nuclear Nightmare
results.overview: The definitive account of Japan’s struggle as it faced a nuclear catastrophe while still reeling from the devastation of an earthquake and tsunami.

results.title: Play Me
results.overview: IT BEGINS KIND OF CUTE... IT ENDS OBSCENE! IN BETWEEN FLIGHTS, THEY HIJACK THE SCREEN! A brief encounter at Brussels Airport between a famous livestreamer and a young woman takes a wild turn once money and the audience get involved.

results.title: Woodwalkers 2
results.overview: For shapeshifter Carag and his friends Brandon, Holly, and Lou, a new school year begins at Clearwater High. But first, the Woodwalker Council must decide whether Carag's mentor and patron of the school, Andrew Milling, is guilty of attacking humans. Carag is in a dilemma: he wants to put a stop to Milling's actions, but Milling promises to take him to his true puma family if he covers for him before the council.

results.title: Blue Emanuelle
results.overview: A young woman, alone in her new life, uncovers a hidden reality inside her home, one that promises the arrival of love.

results.title: Dominion of Darkness: Rephaim
results.overview: Following a catastrophic, failed ritual in a remote Indonesian province, two Catholic exorcists are deployed to confront a devastatingly powerful ancient entity unleashed by an ancestral pact for illicit wealth.

results.title: Down the Hatch
results.overview: The drama of a girl whose mother began to live in a wine bottle.

results.title: Polong
results.overview: Maria Hadi tried to seek forgiveness before she died, but her defense team vented their grudge against the innocent heir.

results.title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: The 48 Hours That Changed Spain
results.original_title: Miguel Ángel Blanco: Las 48 horas que lo cambiaron todo
results.overview: This documentary explores how Miguel Ángel Blanco's 1997 abduction turned fear into collective resistance and shaped Spain's fright Against ETA terrorism.

results.title: The Stories
results.overview: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

results.title: Prostokvashino
results.overview: A boy nicknamed Uncle Fyodor loved animals very much, but his parents didn't want to hear anything about having a pet in their apartment. So Uncle Fyodor had to move to the village of Prostokvashino with his new friends — the cat Matroskin and the faithful dog Sharik.

results.title: Fiesta Pagäna
results.overview: The movie chronicles the untold story of the band from their origins in the 1980s, highlighting their rise to fame, creative tensions, line-up changes, internal dynamics, controversies, and fan culture.

results.title: Djävulens krig
results.overview: On snow-covered fields in the small village of Napue in Ostrobothnia, a terribly one-sided battle is being fought in the bitter February cold. The Swedish army numbers 4,500 men. The Russian force consists of over 10,000 soldiers. The odds are impossible to overcome, and the Swedish defeat is total. The year is 1714, and the entire eastern half of the kingdom is now under Russian control. The era of the Great Northern War has begun.

results.title: The Keeper of the Camphor Tree
results.overview: Reito Naoi, a young man fired unfairly from his day job, finds himself hitting rock bottom when he's arrested after a desperate attempt to get back on his feet. With nothing left to him, he surrendered himself to fate, giving up on any hopes for the future, and lost the will to make his own choices in life. But one day, a chance encounter threw him a lifeline that could change his fate forever.

results.title: Doctor Glas
results.overview: The lonely doctor Gabriel Glas despises society's superficiality - until the fashion designer Helga enters his life. She's trapped in a destructive marriage, and Gabriel sees his chance to save her. Soon, they are caught in a web of lies, desire, and power. The deeper Gabriel is drawn into the relationship, the more moral boundaries he crosses - with catastrophic consequences.
